# Isola

> Owner-operated concrete, masonry and sitework contractor based in
> Providence, Rhode Island. Serves property managers, commercial owners,
> medical and office properties, general contractors, and homeowners in
> Rhode Island and southeastern Massachusetts.

## What we do
- Concrete sidewalks, steps, pads, curbs and trip-hazard repair
- Brick and block masonry repair and repointing
- Retaining wall repair and rebuilds
- Paver walkways, patios and hardscape
- Drainage improvements and runoff control
- Asphalt and parking area repair
- Exterior property maintenance for managed properties

## How we work
The owner walks every job, diagnoses why something failed before pricing
the fix, and is on site during the work. Every project includes Isola
SiteLine, a private page showing project phase and next crew visit.
Licensed and insured.

## Where we work
Providence, Cranston, Warwick, East Providence, Pawtucket, North
Providence, Johnston, Smithfield, Lincoln, Cumberland, East Greenwich,
Bristol, and nearby towns in Rhode Island; Attleboro, North Attleboro
and Seekonk in Massachusetts.
